name: API.market MCP Gateway
description: Proprietary hosted MCP gateway for API discovery, operation lookup, execution, usage checks and subscription management through five tools. Streamable HTTP with OAuth or API-key authentication; API.market account required. Free tiers, quotas, paid plans and usage charges vary by API. Calls and subscription changes can incur charges. Public integration metadata is separate from server source.
